001package com.streamconverter.command;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004import java.io.InputStream;
005import java.io.OutputStream;
006import org.slf4j.Logger;
007
008/**
009 * Unified interface for stream commands.
010 *
011 * <p>This interface defines methods for executing commands on input streams and writing results to
012 * output streams.
013 *
014 * <p>This is a functional interface and can be implemented using lambda expressions or method
015 * references for simple stream processing operations.
016 *
017 * <p>Usage examples:
018 *
019 * <pre>{@code
020 * // Simple copy operation (IOException is propagated from execute method signature)
021 * IStreamCommand copyCommand = (in, out) -> in.transferTo(out);
022 *
023 * // Buffered stream processing with custom logic
024 * IStreamCommand bufferCommand = (in, out) -> {
025 *     byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
026 *     int len;
027 *     while ((len = in.read(buffer)) != -1) {
028 *         out.write(buffer, 0, len);
029 *     }
030 * };
031 *
032 * // Using in StreamConverter pipeline
033 * StreamConverter converter = StreamConverter.create(copyCommand);
034 * converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
035 * }</pre>
036 */
037@FunctionalInterface
038public interface IStreamCommand {
039
040  /**
041   * Executes the command on the provided input stream and writes the result to the output stream.
042   *
043   * @param inputStream The input stream to read data from.
044   * @param outputStream The output stream to write data to.
045   * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurs during the execution of the command.
046   */
047  void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException;
048
049  /**
050   * Wraps this command with logging. The returned command logs start, completion, and failure using
051   * the provided logger.
052   *
053   * <p>The command name is derived from {@code this.getClass().getSimpleName()} at wrap time. When
054   * this command is implemented as a lambda or method reference, the underlying class is synthetic
055   * and the derived name may not be meaningful. In such cases, prefer {@link #withLogging(Logger,
056   * String)} to provide an explicit command name.
057   *
058   * @param logger the logger to write messages to
059   * @return a new {@link IStreamCommand} that delegates to this command and emits log records
060   */
061  default IStreamCommand withLogging(Logger logger) {
062    Class<?> implClass = this.getClass();
063    String commandName = implClass.isSynthetic() ? "IStreamCommand" : implClass.getSimpleName();
064    return withLogging(logger, commandName);
065  }
066
067  /**
068   * Wraps this command with logging using an explicit command name.
069   *
070   * <p>This overload is recommended when the command is implemented as a lambda expression or
071   * method reference, where the underlying class name might be synthetic and not meaningful in
072   * logs.
073   *
074   * @param logger the logger to write messages to
075   * @param commandName the human-readable name of this command to appear in log messages
076   * @return a new {@link IStreamCommand} that delegates to this command and emits log records
077   */
078  default IStreamCommand withLogging(Logger logger, String commandName) {
079    return (in, out) -> {
080      logger.info("Starting command: {}", commandName);
081      long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
082      try {
083        this.execute(in, out);
084        logger.info(
085            "Completed command: {} ({}ms)", commandName, System.currentTimeMillis() - start);
086      } catch (IOException e) {
087        logger.error("Failed command: {} - {}", commandName, e.getMessage(), e);
088        throw e;
089      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
090        logger.error("Failed command: {} - {}", commandName, e.getMessage(), e);
091        throw e;
092      } catch (Error e) {
093        logger.error("Fatal error in command: {} - {}", commandName, e.getMessage(), e);
094        throw e;
095      }
096    };
097  }
098}
